summary.text: John Jagler is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 13 since April 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A former radio host and business owner, he previously served in the State Assembly from 2013 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: John Jagler lives in Watertown, Wisconsin.
His career experience includes working as a radio show host, as communications director for former Assembly Speaker Jeff Fitzgerald, and as owner of Jagler Communications.
Jagler represented Assembly District 37 from 2013 to 2021 and assumed office in the Senate on April 23, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Education Committee, is vice-chair of the Committee on Financial Institutions and Sporting Heritage, and serves on the Joint Legislative Council.
